introHtml: Brown sweaters and cardigans offer a warm, professional alternative to standard black or navy. Whether you choose a cozy Women's Boxercraft Cuddle Cardigan for casual office days or a structured Ladies' Mercer+Mettle™ Open Front Cardigan for a polished look, brown pairs well with earth-tone logos and adds a grounded feel to any uniform. These bulk orders are ideal for fall promotions, employee gifts, or retail teams. Decorate with embroidered logos or screen-printed designs for a lasting impression.
